{{Top|leg}}
The '''Energy discharge weapon''' was a weapon coupled with a [[Offensive sensor node]], a build option for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Mobile Defense Unit]]. This weapon not only allowed the offensive sensor node to gather data, it allowed the device to defend itself.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''
